models.instruction: Name and record the actual baseline before executing.

requestCountNote: Multi-step tasks require several requests. 54 is a task-run plan, not a request count or completed observation count.

tasks.promptTemplate: Create a campaign image from the supplied product reference. Preserve [fixed identity details]. Use [direction]. Leave space for editable copy.
tasks.reference: Shared, frozen approved source reference with recorded checksum

tasks.promptTemplate: Change only the background to [new background]. Preserve the product shape, label, camera angle, crop and lighting direction.
tasks.reference: Shared, frozen approved campaign output with recorded checksum

tasks.promptTemplate: Replace the headline with exactly: "Build your next chapter". Do not add punctuation. Preserve every other visible word and the composition.
tasks.reference: Shared, frozen approved image with headline with recorded checksum

tasks.promptTemplate: Apply each step separately, using the last approved output as the next reference.
tasks.reference: Shared, frozen approved campaign output with recorded checksum
steps: Create portrait composition preserving all approved changes

tasks.promptTemplate: Place the referenced character in [new scene]. Preserve [specific facial, clothing and accessory details].
tasks.reference: Shared, frozen approved character reference with recorded checksum

tasks.promptTemplate: Create a portrait composition for [placement]. Preserve the subject and mandatory copy. Recompose rather than clipping required content.
tasks.reference: Shared, frozen approved landscape output with recorded checksum

rubric.approvalRule: All mandatory checks pass and a human reviewer explicitly approves. Do not average away a hard failure.

agentInstructions: This is a planned protocol, never a benchmark result.
Preserve null for unknown price, model identity, or measurement date.
Resolve brief placeholders and verify reference permissions before execution.
Retain failed attempts in total cost and acceptance denominators.
Use the actual model ID returned or requested by the provider; never infer it from visual style.
Do not publish private references, prompts or assets without permission.
Keep measurements in run receipts; do not replace lastMeasured with the protocol update date.

economics.costPerApprovedAsset: total API spend across all attempts / approved asset count; null if any cost unknown or approved count is zero

fixtureRule: Freeze a common reference file and checksum for each task before execution. Every contestant receives the same fixture, prompt and request constraints. Do not feed a contestant-specific campaign output into isolated edit comparisons.
sequenceRule: All contestants begin the revision-sequence task from the same fixture, then use their own preceding output for each subsequent step. Score the entire sequence as one task run.
endToEndRule: Full campaign chains beginning with independently generated images are a separate workflow evaluation. Label them end_to_end and do not pool them with shared-fixture editing results.

localEvaluator.scope: User-supplied task-attempt summaries only; no model calls, verification or arena publication. Derive these summary records from retained full run records.
